full_judgment:
Badrul Islam Choudhury J: Registered as a Criminal Miscellaneous Case. This motion under section 561A CrPC is directed against the judgment and order dated 10-6-97 passed by Mr Afzal Hossain Ahmed, Sessions Judge, Dinajpur in Criminal Revision No. 48/96 rejecting the revisional application and confirming the order dated 20-6-96 passed by Mr Shafiqul Islam, Magistrate, 1st Class, Dinajpur framing charge under sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act in Complaint Case No. 1126C/95. 

 3. By the impugned order dated 20-6-96 the learned Magistrate framed charge against accused petitioner Md Moniruzzaman (Dablu) under section 4 and charge under section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against the rest of the accused persons. On perusal of the certified copy of the petition of complaint, filed by Mst Sahana Akhter, the complainant we find that there is no allegation of taking dowry by the husband or any of his relations. The allegation is of demanding dowry with threat to divorce the complainant if the demand is not satisfied. So the activities of the sccused petitioners come within the mischief of section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and not under section 3. As such, the Magistrate committed illegality in framing charge under section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against accused petitioner Nos. 2-5. He should have framed charge under section 4 against all the accused persons of the case. Therefore, order dated 20-6-96 so far as it relatios to framing of charge against petitioner Nos. 2-5 under section 3 is set aside and the learned Magistrate is directed to frame charge under section 4 against these petitioners and then proceed with the trial.
